title: Robot on Neon Path
description: A weathered brass robot with glowing yellow eyes walks along a winding stone path made of circuit boards and maze patterns. It holds a dripping cyan candle that emits a swirling stream of colorful musical notes, gears, peace symbols, and papers against a dark background with concentric circles and hanging light bulbs.
prompt: A detailed steampunk robot with glowing yellow eyes and a translucent green ghost-like helmet walks along a winding white stone path composed of circuit boards and maze designs. The robot holds a melting cyan candle that drips green wax and emits a swirling colorful stream of musical notes, gears, peace signs, and papers flowing into the dark sky. The background features concentric circles, hanging light bulbs, and distant mountains. Surreal digital art style with vibrant accents.
